scope: Native Qt Store in Xvfb container; not ISO desktop or website/game playback

scenarios.name: search-and-empty
scenarios.detail: Search, empty state and clear all work.

scenarios.name: actual-android-gates
scenarios.detail: All requested Android entries are visibly pending; no APK/provider is installed.

scenarios.name: cancel-runtime-start
scenarios.detail: Development runtime acknowledgement can be cancelled; no emulator, licence acceptance or download starts.

scenarios.name: publisher-info-cancel
scenarios.detail: Opening an external site can be cancelled; no browser started.

scenarios.name: activity-controls
scenarios.detail: Local controls/action log visible; no account information used.

scenarios.name: close-reopen
scenarios.detail: Store closes and reopens without a resident downloader.
